Mexicano offers a unique twist to traditional padel tournaments.

Mixicano: Mixicano is a fun and inclusive padel tournament format that promotes gender diversity and teamwork. It is a mixed doubles tournament where each team consists of one male and one female player. Mixicano tournaments encourage players of all skill levels to participate and enjoy the sport together. NUMBER OF PARTICIPANTS
Our app is designed to accommodate any number of players, unlike other apps in the market. We specialize in creating a tournament generator that can effectively manage varying player counts, whether it's low, high, or uneven.

Based on a predetermined number of points per game (e.g. 21 points) the team that takes the most number of points will be the winner of the match. This also means that being the winner or loser of the match is irrelevant. The reason for this is that each point counts in your individual results.
